original_text: Establishment of Class E Airspace; Columbus, TX — This action proposes to establish Class E airspace at Columbus Community Hospital Heliport, Columbus, TX. The FAA is proposing this action to support new instrument procedures and instrument flight rule (IFR) operations.

Amendment of Class E Airspace; Del Rio, TX — This action amends the Class E airspace at Del Rio, TX. This action is the result of a biennial review of the airspace associated with Laughlin Air Force Base (AFB), Del Rio, TX. This proposal also updates the name and geographic coordinates of Laughlin AFB to coincide with the FAA's aeronautical database. This action brings the airspace into compliance with FAA orders and supports instrument flight rule (IFR) procedures and operations.

Connect America Fund; A National Broadband Plan for Our Future High-Cost Universal Support, Reforming the High-Cost Program for an All-IP Future, Safeguarding Universal Service Funding Through Effective Applicant Vetting — In this document, the Federal Communications Commission (FCC or Commission) initiates a rulemaking to establish a vetting process for applicants for, and other recipients of, certain new funding awards of high-cost Universal Service Fund (USF) support.

Amendment of Class D and E Airspace and Removal of Class E Airspace Over Lebanon, NH — This action proposes to amend Class D and Class E airspace over Lebanon, NH. This action would increase the lateral dimensions of the Lebanon, NH, Class D airspace to appropriately contain Instrument Flight Rules (IFR) operations at the Lebanon Municipal Airport. original_text: Regulations Implementing the Privacy Act — The Occupational Safety and Health Review Commission (OSHRC) is proposing revisions to its regulations implementing the Privacy Act of 1974.
